function coiledLead(a, b, color, { turns=14, coilRadius=0.22, tube=0.035 } = {}) {
  const dir = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(b,a);
  const len = dir.length();
  const axis = dir.clone().normalize();
  // build orthonormal basis
  const up = Math.abs(axis.y) > 0.9 ? new THREE.Vector3(1,0,0) : new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0);
  const n1 = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(axis, up).normalize();
  const n2 = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(axis, n1).normalize();
  const pts = [];
  const N = turns * 12;
  for (let i=0;i<=N;i++){
    const t = i/N;
    const ang = t * turns * Math.PI*2;
    const p = a.clone().addScaledVector(dir, t)
      .addScaledVector(n1, Math.cos(ang)*coilRadius)
      .addScaledVector(n2, Math.sin(ang)*coilRadius);
    pts.push(p);
  }
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts, false, 'catmullrom', 0.2);
  return new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, N, tube, 8, false), rubberMat(color));
}
